import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageFilter
im = Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
arr = np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)
# background estimates at multiple scales
b1 = np.asarray(im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(15))).astype(np.float32)
b2 = np.asarray(im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(60))).astype(np.float32)
d = b1-b2  # positive where locally darker than large-scale
# restrict to bone region y 350..1000, x 250..2200
mask = np.zeros_like(d)
mask[350:1000, 250:2200]=1
d2 = d*mask
print('min',d2.min(),'max',d2.max())
lo,hi = np.percentile(d2[mask==1],1), np.percentile(d2[mask==1],99)
print(lo,hi)
out = np.clip((d2-lo)/(hi-lo)*255,0,255).astype(np.uint8)
Image.fromarray(out).resize((2000,1013)).save('darkmap.png')
print('ok')
""}
